name: SNAP enrollment help
description: Help applying for SNAP (food stamps), plus referrals to housing help, medical care and counseling.

name: E.P. on Wheels mobile meals
description: Mobile community kitchen serving meals at stops across central New Jersey; check the website for the stop schedule.

name: Free blood pressure screening (Promise Clinic intake)
description: Saturday blood pressure screening run by Rutgers medical students; it is also how new patients get into the free Promise Clinic.
eligibility: Uninsured adults who use Elijah's Promise

name: Housing counseling (Housing Coalition of Central Jersey)
description: HUD-certified housing counseling: homebuyer education, mortgage and foreclosure help, landlord-tenant mediation, housing discrimination help and homelessness prevention.
eligibility: Middlesex County residents; homebuyer counseling for low and moderate income households
hours: Mon-Fri 9 am-5 pm, call for an appointment

name: Weatherization Assistance Program
description: Free energy audit and home repairs that lower heating bills: insulation, weatherstripping, smoke/CO detectors, heating system repair or replacement.
eligibility: Eligible Middlesex County households (income rules apply)

name: Multi Services Center (benefits and referrals)
description: Needs assessment and referrals for benefit programs, health care access, housing, child support, legal and rental assistance.
eligibility: Low and moderate income Middlesex County residents
hours: Mon-Fri 9 am-5 pm, call for an appointment

name: Boaz Immigration and Counseling Program
description: Immigration counseling with a BIA-accredited representative, help with petitions and applications, legal clinics, ESL classes and citizenship test prep.
eligibility: Central New Jersey individuals and families

name: ENLACE senior services
description: Helps seniors sign up for energy assistance, weatherization, food programs, SNAP and health insurance; peer connection programs.
eligibility: Adults 55+ in Greater New Brunswick and Middlesex County
hours: Mon-Fri 9 am-5 pm, call for an appointment

name: Hospital Violence Intervention Program
description: Trauma-informed counseling and case management for people injured by community violence and treated by RWJ's trauma service.
eligibility: Ages 18-40, Middlesex County (also Franklin Twp and Plainfield), admitted to RWJ Trauma Service for a violence injury

name: LSNJ statewide legal hotline
description: Free civil legal help (housing, benefits, family, consumer) for low-income New Jersey residents, by phone or online application.

name: NJ 211
description: 24/7 information and referral for housing, food, utilities, health care and other local help, by phone, text (your ZIP to 898-211) or chat.

name: Rutgers UBHC Access Center
description: Single number to schedule behavioral health services for children, adults, couples and older adults.
eligibility: Anyone; insurance and cost depend on program

name: Rutgers UBHC crisis and mobile response (Middlesex)
description: Mental health crisis services: call or text 988; mobile response team for Essex and Middlesex Counties, psychiatric emergency screening and a crisis receiving and stabilization center.

name: NJ MentalHealthCares
organization: Mental Health Association in New Jersey
description: Statewide behavioral health information and referral: connects callers to outpatient, inpatient, housing, legal and self-help services, with phone counseling and follow-up.
